proposal.summary: Align SBX-REM-LIST contract with pinned AuthService: Authorization Bearer sessions and existing generic JSON error; retain priority filters and 401 redirect semantics.
proposal.patch:
diff --git a/contracts/sbx-rem-list.openapi.yaml b/contracts/sbx-rem-list.openapi.yaml
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/contracts/sbx-rem-list.openapi.yaml
@@ -0,0 +1,129 @@
+openapi: 3.0.3
+info:
+  title: SBX-REM-LIST Reminder List API
+  version: 1.0.0
+  description: >-
+    Contract for the existing reminder listing endpoint, extended to require a
+    valid session and preserve priority filtering. The client redirects to
+    login when the service returns an unauthenticated response.
+servers:
+  - url: /
+paths:
+  /api/reminders:
+    get:
+      operationId: listReminders
+      summary: List reminders for a valid session
+      description: >-
+        Only an authenticated user with a valid session can list reminders.
+        Sessions expire after thirty minutes. Without a valid session,
+        respond with HTTP 401 and the generic error, without returning any
+        reminders. The frontend redirects the user to login on HTTP 401.
+        Preserve the existing text search and priority filters, which may
+        be combined. Omit priority to include all priorities.
+      x-requirement-ids:
+        - REQ-SBX-R-ERR-FRONTEND
+        - REQ-SBX-R-PRIORITY-FILTER
+        - REQ-SBX-R-SESSION-REQUIRED
+        - REQ-SBX-R-SESSION-REQUIRED-FRONTEND
+      security:
+        - bearerAuth: []
+      parameters:
+        - name: q
+          in: query
+          required: false
+          description: Existing optional text search; can be combined with priority.
+          schema:
+            type: string
+        - name: priority
+          in: query
+          required: false
+          description: >-
+            Optional priority filter. Omit to list reminders of all
+            priorities. Any value other than HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW
+            yields HTTP 400.
+          schema:
+            type: string
+            enum:
+              - HIGH
+              - MEDIUM
+              - LOW
+      responses:
+        '200':
+          description: List of reminders for the authenticated session
+          content:
+            application/json:
+              schema:
+                type: array
+                items:
+                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Reminder'
+        '400':
+          description: Invalid priority parameter
+          content:
+            application/json:
+              schema:
+                $ref: '#/components/schemas/GenericError'
+              example:
+                error: SBX-E-GENERIC
+          x-error-codes:
+            - SBX-E-GENERIC
+        '401':
+          description: >-
+            Missing, expired, or otherwise invalid session; no reminders
+            are disclosed and the frontend must redirect to login.
+          content:
+            application/json:
+              schema:
+                $ref: '#/components/schemas/GenericError'
+              example:
+                error: SBX-E-GENERIC
+          x-error-codes:
+            - SBX-E-GENERIC
+        '500':
+          description: Generic error without internal implementation details
+          content:
+            application/json:
+              schema:
+                $ref: '#/components/schemas/GenericError'
+          x-error-codes:
+            - SBX-E-GENERIC
+components:
+  securitySchemes:
+    bearerAuth:
+      type: http
+      scheme: bearer
+      description: >-
+        Send the opaque login token in the Authorization header as
+        Bearer <token>. The existing AuthService validates it and applies
+        the configured session expiration (30 minutes by default).
+  schemas:
+    Reminder:
+      type: object
+      required:
+        - id
+        - text
+        - at
+        - priority
+      properties:
+        id:
+          type: integer
+          format: int64
+        text:
+          type: string
+        at:
+          type: string
+        priority:
+          type: string
+          enum:
+            - HIGH
+            - MEDIUM
+            - LOW
+    GenericError:
+      type: object
+      description: Existing generic authentication error payload with no sensitive details.
+      required:
+        - error
+      properties:
+        error:
+          type: string
+          enum:
+            - SBX-E-GENERIC
